entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Sachini D. Ranasinghe, also known as S.D. Ranasinghe, is a Sri Lankan chess player who holds the title of Woman International Master. She is the first 
Sri Lankan player to get awarded the title of Woman International Master and only Sri Lankan player to win Asian zonal 3.2 chess championship and participate at the World chess Cup in 2012. She is a five-time winner of the Sri Lankan Women's Chess Championship. She is the strongest Sri Lankan women chess player in this era.
